input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: Section 1 (Kubient Services) expressly disclaims any exclusive arrangement and confirms AP remains free to offer or sell Inventory through other agents or third parties, which matches our preferred position of no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on the Customer. Searches for "exclusiv", "sole", "minimum" and requirements/third-party restriction patterns surface no covenant binding AP to deal only with Kubient: the other "exclusive" references are a non-exclusive license grant to AP (p0002), exclusive jurisdiction (p0064), each Party's own trademark ownership (p0065), the entire-agreement clause (p0072) and the no-third-party-beneficiary clause (p0073). There is also no minimum volume or non-compete commitment (p0014, p0062 confirm no revenue guarantee). No redline required.
